SofarCore release form (rust-core 5.2, D55): `crates/sofar-ffi/build-apple.sh --test --dist <url-base>` strips debug info only (strip -S) and writes target/apple/dist/ with sofar_ffiFFI.xcframework.zip (~9 MB), sofar_ffi.swift and Package.swift (binaryTarget url+checksum). release.yml's `apple` job runs it on macos-26 and creates the tag's GitHub release.
